rules: Only the generated hero can purchase in its own team build area.
One ability per Z/X/C/V slot; occupied slot rejects further purchases.
Each ability can be learned only once per team.
Only one Z AoE ability per team.
Successful purchase adds level-1 ability and removes token; denied purchases refund configured price and restock token.
Build closes after 45 seconds and all 32 shops are removed.
No script to upgrade purchased ability levels or free/reassign slots was found. UnitAddAbility does not itself make purchased spells part of the hero skill-learning list.
No explicit UnitMakeAbilityPermanent call is present in the purchase handler.
Shops use n000 and retain its 11 static items while adding 12 tokens. Actual command-card visibility of all added stock requires game verification.

summons.name: Siege Engine
summons.summary: Summons one Siege Engine for 40s: 1300 HP, 50 fortified armor, 275 move speed. Enabled weapon 1 deals 151-161 siege damage every 1s at 250 range, targeting structures/debris only. Weapon 2 data exists but attacks-enabled=1 disables it. No unit abilities.

summons.name: Penguin of Chaos
summons.summary: Summons 12 Penguins of Chaos for 120s each: 15000 HP, 35 fortified armor, 500 move speed, 1 HP/s regeneration. Weapon 1: 101-108 chaos damage every 0.5s at 128 range vs ground/debris/items/wards. Weapon 2: 51-58 chaos damage every 2s at 128 range vs structures. 70% cleave in 200 radius; 900-radius aura reduces enemy attack and move speed by 80%; spell immunity (magic damage factor 0) and Resistant Skin.
